scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build
